full_judgment: 12. Admittedly, the suit property belonged to Gopal Chandra Mukherjee, predecessor of defendants. The plaintiffs father was the bargadar under the defendants. The plaintiff claims that in 1355 BS he took oral settlement of the suit property from the defendants at a salami of Taka 500 and at the rent of Taka 5 per annum. The contesting defendant No. 5 disowned such fact its case was that the suit property was correctly recorded in their names in SA operation. It appears from the evidence on record that the plaintiff failed to produce any document in support of the oral settlement. There is no evidence that the plaintiff made an attempt for executing kabuliyat or patta, Moreover, PWs 1-3 made contradictory statement in respect of oral settlement.
